content.text:
Updated the package to match all ten sections of `SPEC.md`. The parser now handles whitespace, comments, and all three `converted` values, and reports the original line number for malformed records. Deduplication keeps the last input record for each ID, even when it has an earlier day.

The package-wide review also corrected group ranking, per-group rate ordering, and conversion streaks. Updated the README API list and added regression tests, including the requested `None` and duplicate-ID cases.

Verification: `python -m pytest -q` — **16 passed**.
